entities.name: Query RibBA
observations: 393 aa protein; predicted two-domain RibBA fusion with N-terminal DHBP synthase domain (PF00926, residues 7-197) and C-terminal GTP cyclohydrolase II domain (PF00925, residues 209-368).
Strong homology to reviewed Staphylococcus RibBA proteins: 75.3-76.8% identity over 100% query coverage; E-values 6.71e-219 to 9.03e-224.

Inferred to catalyze two riboflavin-biosynthesis reactions: D-ribulose 5-phosphate conversion to 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone 4-phosphate plus formate, and GTP conversion to a ribitylamino pyrimidinone phosphate intermediate plus formate and pyrophosphate.
Homolog annotations report binding of two Mg2+/Mn2+ ions and one Zn2+ ion per subunit; this cofactor assignment is transferred by homology, not directly experimentally established for the query.

entities.name: RibBA
observations: Bifunctional riboflavin biosynthesis protein combining 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone 4-phosphate synthase and GTP cyclohydrolase II activities.
Associated EC activities are EC 4.1.99.12 and EC 3.5.4.25; reactions correspond to Rhea 18457 and Rhea 23704.
The N-terminal region performs DHBP synthase activity and the C-terminal region performs GTP cyclohydrolase II activity.

entities.name: Riboflavin biosynthesis
observations: RibBA contributes the first committed enzymatic steps represented in the fused bacterial RibBA protein: DHBP formation from D-ribulose 5-phosphate and GTP cyclohydrolase II formation of the pyrimidine precursor.
The query is predicted to be cytosolic based on homolog annotation.
